## Shaped
Iteration 0196 measures tools and does no product work. Positive-control step 4 was blocked twice with nothing saved: #834 in 0194 and #838 in 0195. Both times Read and Grep returned "No such tool available ... disabled for this session" (`.session/reports/838.json`). The working memory said not to order the same full task a third time. This iteration instead runs two short probes in parallel:
- `tool-probe-benchmark-0196` (benchmark/default/low, 15 min/12 turns)
- `tool-probe-researcher-0196` (researcher/default/low, 15 min/12 turns)

Each probe tries Read, Grep, Glob, Bash python3, Bash git, Write and Edit once. It puts a per-tool table on the first lines of its report and writes only its own `.session/artifacts/tool-probe-<role>-0196.txt`, so the two tasks share no files. Comparing the roles shows whether the tool block is role-specific or global.

`.session/tasks.json` passed the direct Python JSON/field/heading check (exit 0). `journal/working-memory.md` is rewritten with all four sections.

## What next
- If the benchmark probe passes: re-order the step 4 task (`positive-control-author-0195`) and its review (`positive-control-review-0195`) from record 0195 without changes.
- If only the researcher probe passes: send the evidence to the Policymaker in `.session/suggestions.json` and order researcher-role work meanwhile.
- If both fail: report a global blocker and order no busywork.
- Do not re-derive the #828/#831 findings.

- The Policymaker has not acted yet on the disabled-tools suggestion raised in 0195: `policy_rev` is still 5e598014 (`.session/loop-state.json`).
